summary:
Implementation plan for adding a centered modal popup loading screen with animated spinner and variant count progress when reading VCF files.
Defines VcfLoadingScreen modal dialog in src/vcfscape/ui/screens/vcf_loading_screen.py.
Adds real-time progress callbacks to VcfReader to stream live scanned line counts.
Integrates the loading popup into VcfscapeApp on mount and auto-dismisses upon readiness, with an optional Escape key to dismiss early into the initial slice.
